name: Greece
dek: Elliniko, 1955–2010, from the Hellenic weather service. Not a 1991–2020 normal, and not Santorini.
paragraphs: Greece has no folder in the NOAA NCEI 1991–2020 collection. The table is the Hellenic National Meteorological Service page for Elliniko, which prints the period 1955–2010, altitude 43 m, latitude 37.89, longitude 23.74. The rows are the page's own labels: maximum monthly temperature, minimum monthly temperature, and monthly mean precipitation height. Charts on that page mark the axes as temperature in C and precipitation in mm. This is the Athens-area station, not a national average.

The South Aegean list on the same service, opened the same day, names Naxos and Rodos. Santorini is not on that list, so the Santorini sheet does not borrow Elliniko. July and August share the highest maximum in this table, and December is the heaviest precipitation month. The driving rule is Article 20 of the 2025 traffic code. Visit Greece says a restaurant tip is not mandatory.

climate.caption: Reference station: Elliniko, HNMS, period 1955–2010. Not a 1991–2020 normal and not a national average.

The table rows used here are labelled Maximum Monthly Temperature, Minimum Monthly Temperature, and Monthly Mean Precipitation Height. Charts on the same page label the axes Temperature (C) and Precipitation (mm). This is not a 1991–2020 normal, and it is not averaged with any other Greek station. plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C and F, 230 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Greece at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page on 15 November 2026 did not return the list. The archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Article 20(1) of Law 5209/2025, the Road Traffic Code, published in Government Gazette A 100 of 13 June 2025, says right-hand traffic applies on the country's road network. The same paragraph says the driver of every vehicle drives near the right edge of the carriageway even if the whole carriageway is free, subject to Article 16(1) and Article 21(6).

tipping.label: Tipping
tipping.detail: Visit Greece's English page of quick travel tips says tipping is not mandatory, but a 5–10% tip is appreciated in restaurants for good service.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Greece, last reviewed 25 August 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Euro and the code EUR for Greece.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give Greece one row, Europe/Athens. Athens and Santorini are both on that row. There is no second Greek zone in either file.
